verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע פַּשְׁחוּר֙ בֶּן־ אִמֵּ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהֽוּא־ פָקִ֥יד נָגִ֖יד בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֶֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ נִבָּ֖א אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ paš·ḥūr ben- ’im·mêr hak·kō·hên wə·hū- p̄ā·qîḏ nā·ḡîḏ bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh ’eṯ- yir·mə·yā·hū nib·bā ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: When Pashhur the priest . . . the son of Immer and the chief official in the house of the LORD heard Jeremiah prophesying these things
verses.literalPt: E PASUR, filho de Imer, o sacerdote, que havia sido nomeado presidente na casa do SENHOR, ouviu a Jeremias, que profetizava estas palavras.

verses.original: וַיַּכֶּ֣ה פַשְׁח֔וּר אֵ֖ת יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֑יא וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אֹת֜וֹ עַל־ הַמַּהְפֶּ֗כֶת אֲשֶׁ֨ר בְּשַׁ֤עַר בִּנְיָמִן֙ הָֽעֶלְי֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yak·keh p̄aš·ḥūr ’êṯ yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî way·yit·tên ’ō·ṯōw ‘al- ham·mah·pe·ḵeṯ ’ă·šer bə·ša·‘ar bin·yā·min hā·‘el·yō·wn ’ă·šer bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: he had Jeremiah the prophet beaten and put in the stocks at the Upper Gate of Benjamin which was by the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E feriu Pasur ao profeta Jeremias, e o colocou no cepo que está na porta superior de Benjamim, na casa do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וַיֹּצֵ֥א פַשְׁח֛וּר אֶֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מִן־ הַמַּהְפָּ֑כֶת וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ לֹ֤א פַשְׁחוּר֙ קָרָ֤א יְהוָה֙ שְׁמֶ֔ךָ כִּ֖י אִם־ מָג֥וֹר מִסָּבִֽיב׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ way·yō·ṣê p̄aš·ḥūr ’eṯ- yir·mə·yā·hū min- ham·mah·pā·ḵeṯ way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw yir·mə·yā·hū lō p̄aš·ḥūr qā·rā Yah·weh šə·me·ḵā kî ’im- mā·ḡō·wr mis·sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: The next day when Pashhur released Jeremiah from the stocks Jeremiah said to him The LORD does not call . . . you Pashhur but . . . Magor-missabib
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que no dia seguinte Pasur tirou a Jeremias do cepo. Então disse-lhe Jeremias: O SENHOR não chama o teu nome Pasur, mas, Terror por todos os lados.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֡ה הִנְנִי֩ נֹתֶנְךָ֨ לְמָג֜וֹר לְךָ֣ וּלְכָל־ אֹהֲבֶ֗יךָ וְנָֽפְל֛וּ בְּחֶ֥רֶב אֹיְבֵיהֶ֖ם וְעֵינֶ֣יךָ רֹא֑וֹת וְאֶת־ כָּל־ יְהוּדָ֗ה אֶתֵּן֙ בְּיַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֔ל וְהִגְלָ֥ם בָּבֶ֖לָה וְהִכָּ֥ם בֶּחָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nî nō·ṯen·ḵā lə·mā·ḡō·wr lə·ḵā ū·lə·ḵāl- ’ō·hă·ḇe·ḵā wə·nā·p̄ə·lū bə·ḥe·reḇ ’ō·yə·ḇê·hem wə·‘ê·ne·ḵā rō·’ō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- kāl- yə·hū·ḏāh ’et·tên bə·yaḏ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel wə·hiḡ·lām bā·ḇe·lāh wə·hik·kām be·ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD . . . says I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends They will fall by the sword of their enemies before your very eyes . . . - And I will hand Judah over to . . . the king of Babylon and he will carry them away to Babylon and put them to the sword
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que farei de ti um terror para ti mesmo, e para todos os teus amigos. Eles cairão à espada de seus inimigos, e teus olhos o verão. Entregarei todo o Judá na mão do rei de Babilônia; ele os levará presos a Babilônia, e feri-los-á à espada.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֗י אֶת־ כָּל־ חֹ֙סֶן֙ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את וְאֶת־ כָּל־ יְגִיעָ֖הּ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ יְקָרָ֑הּ וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ אוֹצְר֜וֹת מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אֶתֵּן֙ בְּיַ֣ד אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֔ם וּבְזָזוּם֙ וּלְקָח֔וּם וֶהֱבִיא֖וּם בָּבֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- kāl- ḥō·sen hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ wə·’eṯ- kāl- yə·ḡî·‘āh wə·’eṯ- kāl- yə·qā·rāh wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ō·wṣ·rō·wṯ mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh ’et·tên bə·yaḏ ’ō·yə·ḇê·hem ū·ḇə·zā·zūm ū·lə·qā·ḥūm we·hĕ·ḇî·’ūm bā·ḇe·lāh
verses.literal: I will give away all the wealth of this city all its products and valuables and all the treasures of the kings of Judah to their enemies They will plunder them seize them and carry them off to Babylon
verses.literalPt: Também entregarei toda a riqueza desta cidade, e todo o seu trabalho, e todas as suas coisas preciosas, sim, todos os tesouros dos reis de Judá entregarei na mão de seus inimigos, e saqueá-los-ão, e tomá-los-ão e levá-los-ão a Babilônia.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה פַשְׁח֗וּר וְכֹל֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י בֵיתֶ֔ךָ תֵּלְכ֖וּ בַּשֶּׁ֑בִי וּבָבֶ֣ל תָּב֗וֹא וְשָׁ֤ם תָּמוּת֙ וְשָׁ֣ם תִּקָּבֵ֔ר אַתָּה֙ וְכָל־ אֹ֣הֲבֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁר־ נִבֵּ֥אתָ לָהֶ֖ם בַּשָּֽׁקֶר׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh p̄aš·ḥūr wə·ḵōl yō·šə·ḇê ḇê·ṯe·ḵā tê·lə·ḵū baš·še·ḇî ū·ḇā·ḇel tā·ḇō·w wə·šām tā·mūṯ wə·šām tiq·qā·ḇêr ’at·tāh wə·ḵāl ’ō·hă·ḇe·ḵā ’ă·šer- nib·bê·ṯā lā·hem baš·šā·qer
verses.literal: And you Pashhur and all who live in your house will go into captivity You will go to Babylon and there you will die and be buried you and all your friends to whom you have prophesied these lies
verses.literalPt: E tu, Pasur, e todos os moradores da tua casa ireis para o cativeiro; e virás a Babilônia, e ali morrerás, e ali serás sepultado, tu, e todos os teus amigos, aos quais profetizaste falsamente.

verses.original: פִּתִּיתַ֤נִי יְהוָה֙ וָֽאֶפָּ֔ת חֲזַקְתַּ֖נִי וַתּוּכָ֑ל הָיִ֤יתִי לִשְׂחוֹק֙ כָּל־ הַיּ֔וֹם כֻּלֹּ֖ה לֹעֵ֥ג לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: pit·tî·ṯa·nî Yah·weh wā·’ep·pāṯ ḥă·zaq·ta·nî wat·tū·ḵāl hā·yî·ṯî liś·ḥō·wq kāl- hay·yō·wm kul·lōh lō·‘êḡ lî
verses.literal: You have deceived me O LORD and I was deceived You have overcome me and prevailed I am a laughingstock all day long everyone mocks me
verses.literalPt: Persuadiste-me, ó SENHOR, e persuadido fiquei; mais forte foste do que eu, e prevaleceste; sirvo de escárnio todo o dia; cada um deles zomba de mim.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ מִדֵּ֤י אֲדַבֵּר֙ אֶזְעָ֔ק חָמָ֥ס וָשֹׁ֖ד אֶקְרָ֑א כִּֽי־ הָיָ֨ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֥ה לִ֛י לְחֶרְפָּ֥ה וּלְקֶ֖לֶס כָּל־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- mid·dê ’ă·ḏab·bêr ’ez·‘āq ḥā·mās wā·šōḏ ’eq·rā kî- hā·yāh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh lî lə·ḥer·pāh ū·lə·qe·les kāl- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: For whenever I speak I cry out I proclaim violence and destruction For the word of the LORD has become to me a reproach and derision all day long
verses.literalPt: Porque desde que falo, grito, clamo: Violência e destruição; porque se tornou a palavra do SENHOR um opróbrio e ludíbrio todo o dia.

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתִּ֣י לֹֽא־ אֶזְכְּרֶ֗נּוּ וְלֹֽא־ אֲדַבֵּ֥ר עוֹד֙ בִּשְׁמ֔וֹ וְהָיָ֤ה בְלִבִּי֙ כְּאֵ֣שׁ בֹּעֶ֔רֶת עָצֻ֖ר בְּעַצְמֹתָ֑י וְנִלְאֵ֥יתִי כַּֽלְכֵ֖ל וְלֹ֥א אוּכָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tî lō- ’ez·kə·ren·nū wə·lō- ’ă·ḏab·bêr ‘ō·wḏ biš·mōw wə·hā·yāh ḇə·lib·bî kə·’êš bō·‘e·reṯ ‘ā·ṣur bə·‘aṣ·mō·ṯāy wə·nil·’ê·ṯî kal·ḵêl wə·lō ’ū·ḵāl
verses.literal: If I say I will not . . . mention Him or speak any more in His name His message becomes a fire burning in my heart shut up in my bones and I become weary of holding it in and I cannot prevail
verses.literalPt: Então disse eu: Não me lembrarei dele, e não falarei mais no seu nome; mas isso foi no meu coração como fogo ardente, encerrado nos meus ossos; e estou fatigado de sofrer, e não posso mais.

verses.original: כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֜עְתִּי דִּבַּ֣ת רַבִּים֮ מָג֣וֹר מִסָּבִיב֒ הַגִּ֙ידוּ֙ וְנַגִּידֶ֔נּוּ כֹּ֚ל אֱנ֣וֹשׁ שְׁלוֹמִ֔י שֹׁמְרֵ֖י צַלְעִ֑י אוּלַ֤י יְפֻתֶּה֙ וְנ֣וּכְלָה ל֔וֹ וְנִקְחָ֥ה נִקְמָתֵ֖נוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî šā·ma‘·tî dib·baṯ rab·bîm mā·ḡō·wr mis·sā·ḇîḇ hag·gî·ḏū wə·nag·gî·ḏen·nū kōl ’ĕ·nō·wōš šə·lō·w·mî šō·mə·rê ṣal·‘î ’ū·lay yə·p̄ut·teh wə·nū·ḵə·lāh lōw wə·niq·ḥāh niq·mā·ṯê·nū mim·men·nū
verses.literal: For I have heard the whispering of many Terror is on every side Report him let us report him All my trusted friends . . . watch for my fall Perhaps he will be deceived so that we may prevail against him and take our vengeance upon him
verses.literalPt: Porque ouvi a murmuração de muitos, terror de todos os lados: Denunciai, e o denunciaremos; todos os que têm paz comigo aguardam o meu manquejar, dizendo: Bem pode ser que se deixe persuadir; então prevaleceremos contra ele e nos vingaremos dele.

verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֤ה אוֹתִי֙ כְּגִבּ֣וֹר עָרִ֔יץ עַל־ כֵּ֛ן רֹדְפַ֥י יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ וְלֹ֣א יֻכָ֑לוּ בֹּ֤שׁוּ מְאֹד֙ כִּֽי־ לֹ֣א הִשְׂכִּ֔ילוּ כְּלִמַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לֹ֥א תִשָּׁכֵֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ō·w·ṯî kə·ḡib·bō·wr ‘ā·rîṣ ‘al- kên rō·ḏə·p̄ay yik·kā·šə·lū wə·lō yu·ḵā·lū bō·šū mə·’ōḏ kî- lō hiś·kî·lū kə·lim·maṯ ‘ō·w·lām lō ṯiš·šā·ḵê·aḥ
verses.literal: But the LORD is with me like a fearsome warrior Therefore . . . my persecutors will stumble and will not prevail Since they have not succeeded they will be utterly put to shame with an everlasting disgrace that will never be forgotten
verses.literalPt: Mas o SENHOR está comigo como um valente terrível; por isso tropeçarão os meus perseguidores, e não prevalecerão; ficarão muito confundidos; porque não se houveram prudentemente, terão uma confusão perpétua que nunca será esquecida.

verses.original: וַיהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ בֹּחֵ֣ן צַדִּ֔יק רֹאֶ֥ה כְלָי֖וֹת וָלֵ֑ב אֶרְאֶ֤ה נִקְמָֽתְךָ֙ מֵהֶ֔ם כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֖יךָ גִּלִּ֥יתִי אֶת־ רִיבִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ bō·ḥên ṣad·dîq rō·’eh ḵə·lā·yō·wṯ wā·lêḇ ’er·’eh niq·mā·ṯə·ḵā mê·hem kî ’ê·le·ḵā gil·lî·ṯî ’eṯ- rî·ḇî
verses.literal: O LORD of Hosts who examines the righteous who sees the heart and mind let me see Your vengeance upon them for to You I have committed my cause
verses.literalPt: Tu, pois, ó SENHOR dos Exércitos, que provas o justo, e vês os rins e o coração, permite que eu veja a tua vingança contra eles; pois já te revelei a minha causa.

verses.original: שִׁ֚ירוּ לַֽיהוָ֔ה הַֽלְל֖וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י הִצִּ֛יל אֶת־ נֶ֥פֶשׁ אֶבְי֖וֹן מִיַּ֥ד מְרֵעִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: šî·rû Yah·weh hal·lū ’eṯ- Yah·weh kî hiṣ·ṣîl ’eṯ- ne·p̄eš ’eḇ·yō·wn mî·yaḏ mə·rê·‘îm
verses.literal: Sing to the LORD Praise the LORD For He rescues the life of the needy from the hands of evildoers
verses.literalPt: Cantai ao SENHOR, louvai ao SENHOR; pois livrou a alma do necessitado da mão dos malfeitores.

verses.original: אָר֣וּר הַיּ֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלַּ֖דְתִּי בּ֑וֹ י֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יְלָדַ֥תְנִי אִמִּ֖י אַל־ יְהִ֥י בָרֽוּךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer yul·laḏ·tî bōw yō·wm ’ă·šer- yə·lā·ḏaṯ·nî ’im·mî ’al- yə·hî ḇā·rūḵ
verses.literal: Cursed be the day I was born May the day my mother bore me never . . . be blessed
verses.literalPt: Maldito o dia em que nasci; não seja bendito o dia em que minha mãe me deu à luz.

verses.original: אָר֣וּר הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר בִּשַּׂ֤ר אֶת־ אָבִי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יֻֽלַּד־ לְךָ֖ בֵּ֣ן זָכָ֑ר שַׂמֵּ֖חַ שִׂמֳּחָֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr hā·’îš ’ă·šer biś·śar ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî lê·mōr yul·laḏ- lə·ḵā bên zā·ḵār śam·mê·aḥ śim·mo·ḥā·hū
verses.literal: Cursed be the man who brought my father the news saying A son . . . is born to you bringing him great joy . . .
verses.literalPt: Maldito o homem que deu as novas a meu pai, dizendo: Nasceu-te um filho; alegrando-o com isso grandemente.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ הָאִ֣ישׁ הַה֔וּא כֶּֽעָרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־ הָפַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א נִחָ֑ם וְשָׁמַ֤ע זְעָקָה֙ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וּתְרוּעָ֖ה בְּעֵ֥ת צָהֳרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh hā·’îš ha·hū ke·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer- hā·p̄aḵ Yah·weh wə·lō ni·ḥām wə·šā·ma‘ zə·‘ā·qāh bab·bō·qer ū·ṯə·rū·‘āh bə·‘êṯ ṣā·ho·rā·yim
verses.literal: May that man be like the cities that the LORD overthrew without compassion May he hear an outcry in the morning and a battle cry at noon
verses.literalPt: E seja esse homem como as cidades que o SENHOR destruiu e não se arrependeu; e ouça clamor pela manhã, e ao tempo do meio-dia um alarido.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ מוֹתְתַ֖נִי מֵרָ֑חֶם וַתְּהִי־ לִ֤י אִמִּי֙ קִבְרִ֔י וְרַחְמָ֖הֿ הֲרַ֥ת עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer lō- mō·wṯ·ṯa·nî mê·rā·ḥem wat·tə·hî- lî ’im·mî qiḇ·rî wə·raḥ·māh hă·raṯ ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: because he did not kill me in the womb so that my mother might have been my grave and her womb forever enlarged
verses.literalPt: Por que não me matou na madre? Assim minha mãe teria sido a minha sepultura, e teria ficado grávida perpetuamente!

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה זֶּה֙ מֵרֶ֣חֶם יָצָ֔אתִי לִרְא֥וֹת עָמָ֖ל וְיָג֑וֹן וַיִּכְל֥וּ בְּבֹ֖שֶׁת יָמָֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: lām·māh zeh mê·re·ḥem yā·ṣā·ṯî lir·’ō·wṯ ‘ā·māl wə·yā·ḡō·wn way·yiḵ·lū bə·ḇō·šeṯ yā·māy
verses.literal: Why . . . did I come out of the womb to see only trouble and sorrow and to end my days in shame
verses.literalPt: Por que saí da madre, para ver trabalho e tristeza, e para que os meus dias se consumam na vergonha?
